definitions.explanation: Written works, records, or documents used as sources of information, especially in academic research and historical study.

examples.japanese: ⟦{関連|かんれん}→関連：00177_kanren⟧{文献|ぶんけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: I looked into the relevant literature.

examples.japanese: {参考|さんこう}{文献|ぶんけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦リスト→リスト：09786_risuto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末尾|まつび}→末尾：13065_matsubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: Attach a list of references at the end of the paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧{文献|ぶんけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧、⟦{詳|くわ}しい→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧わかって⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Few documents survive from this period, so little is known in detail.

notes:
USAGE:
Primarily an academic and scholarly term. In research, {参考|さんこう}{文献|ぶんけん} (references, bibliography) is the standard term for citing sources. In historical contexts, {文献|ぶんけん} refers to surviving written records.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {参考|さんこう}{文献|ぶんけん}: reference literature, bibliography
- ⟦{関連|かんれん}→関連：00177_kanren⟧{文献|ぶんけん}: related literature
- {文献|ぶんけん}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: literature review, documentary research
- ⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧{文献|ぶんけん}: historical documents

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧: materials, data (broader, includes non-written sources)
- ⟦{文書|ぶんしょ}→文書：12947_bunsho⟧: document, written text (individual document, more official)
